# PDF text extraction dependency

Cairn uses `github.com/giraffesyo/pdf` v0.5.0 for bounded, in-process PDF text extraction.

Source: https://github.com/giraffesyo/pdf/tree/v0.5.0

Module checksum: `h1:xq1gQzlE5W8lW+mJqvu0cB0WkY2AfLCdynPf6t3CN4g=`.
The upstream license is retained in `LICENSE`. Cairn does not bundle the upstream test corpus.
